notes.title: Update 3.1.8 - 3.2
notes.notes:
[*]Fixed inventory windows floating off screen
[*]Added info about attributes when leveling up
[*]Fixed enemies being walled in by RNG
[*]Fixed player not being able to pick loot when very close to walls
[*]Changed possible weapon speeds (melee weapons will be generally faster)
[*]Added image showing the controls. Visible when player presses 'H'

Also I am looking for a graphics designer who would be willing to give me a hand with Steam Cards. Unfortunately I can't offer any remuneration, but if anyone would like to help anyway, mail me at pixelbug@gmx.us for details.

notes.title: Update 3.1.7 – 3.1.8
notes.notes:
[*]Fixed some issues with item tooltips not displaying in the correct language
[*]Fixed inventory showing information about the last selected item, even when it was not highlighted anymore
[*]Equipped shield now flashes when the player is blocking (so the player can be sure he is actually blocking)

Also, I am pretty sure that it is explained in the tutorial signs, but just want to make sure: the shield blocks damage [u]only[/u] when the player is pressing the block button.

Have a nice day!

notes.title: Update 3.1.6 - 3.1.7
notes.notes: No big changes here. Based on user feedback I decided to make tutorial signs spawn on every level, in case the player forgets something and wants to check. Also made sure that the interaction button is mentioned.

notes.title: Launched!
notes.notes:
So the game is finally released, let the looting and killing begin! This wouldn't be possible without my fantastic supporters, thank you! It feels fantastic to see my first game make it to Steam. For any questions / feedback you can contact me under pixelbug@gmx.us

About the Groupees bundle keys - they should be available on their website soon enough, sit tight! They should be available very soon!

notes.title: Almost there!
notes.notes:
Hey everybody!
The game will be released very soon! Tomorrow at about 10 am (GMT +1) it will be available in the store. Be prepared!

An additional surprise is that the game will kickoff with support for a new language: German. (Thanks to the help of a faithful supporter!).

Remember to register an account at [url=http://dungeonsarerandom.eu]dungeonsarerandom.eu[/url] if you are interested in competing for the highest score!
